description: ISC2 CC: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: ISC2, CC and CBK are registered marks of ISC2, Inc. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by ISC2, Inc. It contains no ISC2 exam content and is not built from ISC2 study materials.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 760 cards: those quoting NIST publications against their quotes, found word for word by the card checker, and those written in our own words (the ISC2 outline and ethics code, MITRE ATT&CK) against their sources
checks.result: No wrong answers. One ethics scenario had two defensible answers and was rewritten; 14 ethics cards too close to ISC2's wording were reworded; 2 unsupported claims, 28 unclear cards (mostly jargon a newcomer could not follow) and 23 minor issues were fixed, and five cards were re-sourced to definitions in NIST IR 8286r1, the CNSSI 4009 glossary and SP 800-82r3.
